scoring_justification: T0: recomputing the full quantum dynamical pipeline (radial Schrödinger equation, translational spectral functions, rotational summation) inside the verifier is infeasible; therefore compare the agent's final convolved spectrum to a digitized reference curve from the paper's Fig. 1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference absorption coefficient pairs for the rototranslational spectrum of CH4 at 195 K, used for NRMSE scoring.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 1 of the source paper (Phys. Rev. A 72, 042715, 2005), the solid computed curve at 195 K.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized using WebPlotDigitizer; points smoothed and resampled at 50 cm⁻¹ intervals from 0 to 800 cm⁻¹.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are direct extractions from the published figure, representing the paper's own calculated spectrum.

outputs.description: Rototranslational absorption coefficient α(ω) of CH4 at 195 K, convolved with triangular slit function (half-width 8.75 cm⁻¹), covering wavenumbers 0–800 cm⁻¹.
